title: Chapter 774 Shock; Support!
content:
Chapter 774 Shock; Support!

Chapter 774 Shock; Support!

One had to know…

The blood skeleton's universe ships were all S grade! Even if a king level, no, even a monarch level expert wanted to destroy it, it would take some effort.

In the end, it was a finger!

Lin Fan just pointed casually!

The entire spaceship and everyone in it turned into nothingness.

This was simply unimaginable!

"Phew!"

A breeze blew past.

Lin Fan's expression was still calm.

This was normal…

After all, with Lin Fan's current strength, not to mention a flying ship.

Even if it was a star area, if one wanted to destroy it, it would only take a moment.

Lin Fan turned his body slightly and said to the middle-aged man," You said that Little Stone isn't worthy of marrying your daughter?"

The middle-aged man felt his throat go dry. This..."

He stuttered for a long time but could not say a word.

The strength that Lin Fan had displayed was simply too terrifying.

Little Rock was Lin Fan's man.

Even if he was just a servant, he was definitely not someone she could provoke.

Lin Fan frowned.

Seeing this…

"Yes, yes!" The middle-aged man hurriedly said. My daughter is climbing up the social ladder! My daughter has climbed up the social ladder!"

Even though he was afraid.

But at the same time, it was also his sincere words.

This was because this was a world where the strong reigned supreme.

Since Little Rock had Lin Fan as his master, it could be said that Little Rock had an unimaginable backer.

" Little Stone, you didn't tell them your real age, right?" Lin Fan asked.

"I told them I'm 50,000 years old," Little Rock shook his head.

"Aren't you 50,000 years old?" Xiao Qin asked.

" I've told you before," Little Rock said." I'm a creature born from a rock. However, it's only been 500 years since I came out of the rock."

500 years!

Xiao Qin and the middle-aged man beside her widened their eyes in disbelief.

That was because they all knew that Little Rock's current strength was at the Star Advanced Level.

A 50,000-year-old star advanced level could indeed be considered quite talented.

However, a 500-year-old Advanced Stellar-level was not just talented. He was simply a monster, a monster that he had never heard of before!

After a pause, Little Rock continued," Little Qin, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to hide it from you. I've been hiding my age all these years in the outside world."

" After that, you said you didn't like a relationship between a brother and a sister. That's why I said 50,000 years ago."

"I understand," Xiao Qin said.

Understand?

Yes, she understood too well.

A 500-year-old star level, if this news were to spread, it would definitely shock the entire planet.

The middle-aged man beside him also had a helpless expression on his face.

If he had known that Little Rock was only 500 years old, why would he stop his daughter from being with him?

He couldn't be happier.

The middle-aged man couldn't help but look at Lin Fan. He opened his mouth but didn't dare to say anything.

Little Stone seemed to know what the middle-aged man wanted to say. He snorted and said," The reason why I have the strength I have today is all because of Master!" In addition, Master also has tens of thousands of servants who far surpass my talent!"

Little Rock was obviously referring to those talented people on Earth.

Of course, his words were a little exaggerated.

That was because Little Rock was the leader and the strongest among all the people who had come from Earth. He was also born from the Holy Stone, so his talent was naturally outstanding.

At first, the middle-aged man felt that he was overestimating Lin Fan's identity.

However, after hearing Little Rock's words, the middle-aged man felt that he had still underestimated him.

Tens of thousands of geniuses who far surpassed Little Rock…

What kind of talent and power did Lin Fan have?

Thinking of this, the middle-aged man's throat could not help but feel a little dry.

Lin Fan knew that Little Rock was trying to improve himself, but he didn't care too much.

"Little Rock, didn't you bring them out back then? Why are you alone now?" Lin Fan asked.

"Not long after we came out, we saw a huge black hole. We couldn't help but stop curiously for a while. In the end, the black hole suddenly appeared with a powerful suction force and directly sucked us in…" Little Rock sighed.

"I don't know why I ended up here."

Lin Fan thought for a moment and knew where the black hole that Little Rock was talking about was.

That was probably caused by his battle.

He just didn't expect it to produce a suction force.

Lin Fan nodded," I'm going to the black hole to look. Are you going to stay here or come with me?" Don't be in a hurry to answer. You should discuss it with your little girlfriend first."

Little Rock turned around and said,"Little Qin, you…"

"I'll be with you!" Xiao Qin said without hesitation.

As she spoke, she held Little Rock's hand tightly.

"Master, I'll go with you to the black hole to find them," said Little Rock.

Lin Fan looked at the middle-aged man.

" You can go wherever you want," the middle-aged man said." I'll support you!"

Now that he knew about Little Rock's talent, he couldn't wait for his daughter to marry Little Rock immediately. Why would he object?

Lin Fan nodded," Since that's the case, let's go."

As soon as he finished speaking.

Lin Fan, Little Rock, and Little Qin turned into light spots and disappeared.

Only the middle-aged man was left standing on the spot, exclaiming in amazement,"So fast!"

....

Lin Fan brought along Little Rock and Little Qin as they jumped around in the void.

Five days later, a blue planet appeared in their field of vision.

This... It was Earth.

Little Rock, who had been away from home for decades, had a faint glint in his eyes when he saw Earth.

Xiao Qin, who was beside him, was also attracted by the appearance of Earth. She couldn't help but exclaim,"It's so beautiful!"

" This is Earth," Little Rock said." It's my and Master's hometown."

"Little Stone, your hometown is awesome!" Xiao Qin praised again.

"Phew!"

At this moment, a powerful suction force suddenly appeared from the black hole not far away.

If one's cultivation was slightly weaker, they would be directly sucked into the black hole if they were not careful.

Of course, this suction force was nothing to Lin Fan.

He saw…

Lin Fan's eyes shone with a golden light. However, he was unable to see through this black hole completely.

This piqued Lin Fan's interest.

However, he did not enter immediately.

Instead, he asked the System in his heart, Will it be dangerous for me to enter the black hole?

Even though there were very few things in this world that could threaten Lin Fan anymore.

However, it was never wrong to be a little careful.

[Requires 1 billion spirit stones. Do you wish to inquire?]

Based on Lin Fan's many years of experience, the more spirit stones he consumed, the greater the danger and experts involved.

One billion, obviously wouldn't involve too strong an existence.

Under normal circumstances, there wouldn't be any danger.

However, Lin Fan still chose to ask.

[There won't be any danger.]

Lin Fan heard that and said," Little Rock, Little Qin, let's go in and take a look."

"Alright," said Little Rock.

He had always been very concerned about those people back then. Now that he had the opportunity to find them, he naturally would not miss it.
